name: yf_dividends
description:
Dividend payment history for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance dividends).
Returns: {symbol, data_points (all rows), truncated, dividends: the most recent limit rows, oldest first, each {Date, Dividends (amount per share)}}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T); limit (rows, 1-1000; default 100).
Dividends and splits together: yf_actions; next ex-dividend date: yf_calendar; other source: openbb_dividends.
Example: {"symbol": "KO", "limit": 20}
